title: Jaime Maussan's 2023 presentation of the J-type body
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jaime Maussan's 2023 presentation of the J-type body, about 2023 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So that so in 2023 out so Haime rolled out the J type which is not my highest conviction body type for being real.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2023 a man named Jaime Maussan rolled out what Michels calls the J-type, one of several kinds of bodies said to be non-human. Michels adds that this is not the body type he is most convinced is real.
